tasks.text: Take at least 6 sips from your glass or bottle without using your hands.
Over the course of the game, gently stroke your left-hand neighbor's upper arm 4 times and whisper: 'Everything will be okay soon.'
Untie your shoelaces (or shoes) 5 times during the round, then tie them again with exaggerated slowness.
Say 'But scientists at Harvard have disproved that' completely seriously 5 times in different rounds.
Dramatically cover your eyes for at least 10 seconds at the end of 4 different rounds.
Get at least 3 different players to give you a high five without telling them why.
Click your tongue loudly 8 times, always exactly when a timer drops below 10 seconds.
End 6 of your sentences during the game with a breathy '... Hallelujah!'
Rest your chin flat on the tabletop at least 5 times for 10 seconds each and stare straight ahead in silence.
Blow lightly over your own knuckles 6 times, as if you had to cool down a smoking gun.
Look worried and ask the group 4 times: 'Does anyone smell burnt popcorn?'
Secretly slip an item belonging to your neighbor (e.g. a pen, a coaster) into your trouser pocket during the game.
Bow deeply while seated to the host's phone 3 times and murmur: 'Thank you for your wisdom.'
Speak only in a whisper for two entire rounds, no matter how loudly the others laugh.
Jerk your right shoulder violently 5 times, as if you'd just received an electric shock.
Describe an answer from another player as 'culinarily extremely questionable' 4 times.
Sniff your own T-shirt collar pointedly and deeply 6 times, then nod with satisfaction.
Ask someone the same question 3 times ('Have you aired the place out today, by the way?'), as if you'd forgotten.
For three rounds, enter all answers using only the thumb of your weaker hand.
Yawn heartily and pointedly 5 times in a row, and get at least one other player to yawn too.
Comment on the scoreboard 4x with: 'Pure beginner's luck from those guys up there!'
For 2 rounds, hold your smartphone with both hands right in front of your nose like a piece of crispbread.
Run your thumb and index finger over your upper lip 8x, as if you had a magnificent mustache.
Offer the person opposite you a sip from your glass 3x without being asked, then pull it back at the last moment with a grin.
Sigh deeply, theatrically, and audibly 7x over the course of the game.
Wipe your sleeve over your chair or pant leg 5x and mutter: 'Lint everywhere.'
At the start of 4 rounds, rub your hands together eagerly like a fly over a cake.
Use the old-fashioned word 'Preposterous!' 5x in conversation.
After submitting each answer, spin your phone exactly 3x in a circle on the table.
After a reveal, say to 3 different people, deadpan: 'That's exactly what I would have expected from you.'
Scratch your left eyebrow 6x with a serious expression while voting.
Insist with absolute conviction on at least 3 questions that your aunt wrote a book about exactly that.
Laugh loudly and maliciously like a cartoon villain for at least 10 seconds.
Knock against the underside of the tabletop 5x with your knuckles and pretend it wasn't you.
Shake your head disappointedly toward the ceiling light 4x.
Ask 3 different players: 'Are you sure your battery will last?'
For 5 questions, hold your flat hand over your forehead like a visor to read the display.
Say emphatically 4x: 'Never trust anyone who types faster than they think.'
Secretly fold a paper napkin or a piece of paper into a little boat during the game.
Shift restlessly back and forth in your chair 6x and complain about the cushioning.
Quote this completely out of context in 3 different rounds: 'May the Force be with us.'
Secretly arrange all the other players' glasses or bottles neatly by size.
Keep your left eye tightly shut for an entire guessing round.
Say 5 times after a vote: 'My gut feeling has never let me down!'
Massage your temples 4 times with exaggerated effort and mutter: 'Too much concentrated knowledge.'
Demonstratively roll up your sleeves to your elbows 8 times, then roll them back down shortly afterward.
In the middle of the game, ask 3 times what the exact time is, even though your smartphone is right in front of you.
Wink conspiratorially at the player on your right 5 times during the game.
After each round is resolved, drum a short flourish on the edge of the table with two fingers.
Announce solemnly 3 times: 'From now on, I play without mercy!'
During every guessing round, place your smartphone flat on your head and leave it there for 5 seconds before taking it off.
Speak with an exaggeratedly refined accent for an entire round ('But of course!').
Get 2 other players to hold out a glass or bottle to you at the same time for a toast.
Scratch your chin vigorously 6 times and say thoughtfully: 'Aha... I see...'
Say about 4 questions: 'That was written exactly like that in last week's horoscope!'
At the end of each round, snap your fingers exactly three times with both hands.
Clap your hands together dramatically above your head 3 times and shout: 'Scandalous!'
Move your chair at least ten centimeters farther away from the table 4 times.
Look at someone seriously and say: 'There's something...' then point to your own nose.
Wipe your forehead with the back of your hand 5 times and shake off imaginary sweat.
Comment on 4 answers with: 'My dog would have judged that more logically.'
Rest your chin motionless on both fists for two full rounds.
Offer gum or snacks to 3 different people with exaggerated politeness.
Mutter to yourself 6x: 'Interesting... very interesting...'
Gently blow on your smartphone screen 4x, as if you were blowing out a candle.
End 4 statements with the sentence: '... but please don't hold me to that.'
Sit backward on your chair for one whole round (with the backrest in front of your chest).
Give the person sitting to your left 3x a comforting pat on the shoulder.
Arrange items on the table at perfect right angles to each other, down to the millimeter, 4x.
Ask completely out of the blue 3x: 'Can you hear that strange beeping too?'
Hold your smartphone using only your pinky and thumb for 2 rounds.
At the start of 4 rounds, loudly and formally thank the app for its hospitality.
Tweak your earlobes 6x as if you were readjusting a walkie-talkie.
Cross your legs and rhythmically bounce your foot for at least 3 rounds.
Say to a leading player: 'Pride comes before a fall, my friend!'
Thoroughly clean your glasses (or an imaginary glasses lens) on your T-shirt 4x.
After one round, loudly proclaim: 'I smell a conspiracy!'
Balance a pen or bottle cap on the back of your hand during a vote.
Nod your head 6x with exaggerated enthusiasm while another player explains something.
Say 5x when the score appears: 'Money alone doesn't make you happy, after all.'
Take a sip from your glass, swish it noisily around your mouth, and swallow very slowly.
Let out 4 quiet groans and hold the back of your neck as if you’d caught a draft.
Whisper to your smartphone 3 times: “You and me against the rest of the world.”
Run your palm over the tabletop 5 times and skeptically check for dust.
Congratulate the player in last place after a round with a firm, celebratory handshake.
Remain completely motionless like a statue for 8 seconds during a timer countdown.
Respond to 3 questions with: “Classic trick question from the system!”
Once during the game, switch chairs without being asked, moving to an empty seat in the room.
After 5 round results, examine your fingernails with an extremely critical expression.
Ask the group 3 times, looking concerned: “Is it just me, or is everyone feeling dizzy?”
Hold your hand over your screen like a poker player hiding their cards.
Lavishly praise the host 3 times for their excellent choice of screen colors.
Lightly slap your forehead 4 times with your palm (“Oh, of course, that makes sense!”).
During 3 guesses, claim: “That’s exactly my mother-in-law’s house number.”
During a voting phase, silently stand up, stretch briefly, and sit back down.
Without being asked, clear the crumbs or lint in front of another player’s spot.
After 5 rounds, briefly rub your eyes and mutter: “I’m seeing double already.”
Say 4 times with firm conviction: “Statistically speaking, that’s impossible.”
After 4 inputs, pointedly place your smartphone face down on the table.
Solemnly announce to everyone at the end: “No matter who wins, I’m the people’s champion.”
Rub the sides of your nose 6 times with both index fingers, as if they were really itchy.
With a serious expression, say, “There’s a highly interesting documentary about that on Arte” in response to 4 different questions.
Push your phone across the table using your wrists, without using your fingers.
Get 2 other players to confirm that the room has “suddenly gotten pretty chilly.”
At the start of 3 rounds, briefly and quietly whistle the opening notes of a well-known German pop song.
Stretch your legs way out under the table 4 times, then pull them back in with a startled “Whoa!”
Whisper a fake code word (e.g. “blueberry pie”) in your neighbor’s ear 3 times.
Slap your thighs with your palms 5 times and shout, “All right, now things get serious!”
Comment on 3 other players’ answers with: “Bold... very bold, but unfortunately wrong.”
After every sip, rotate your glass or cup exactly 180 degrees in a circle.
Ask, “Have the points been adjusted for inflation yet?” 3 times.
For two rounds, enter everything by alternating between the index fingers of both hands, and using no other fingers.
Stare silently at another player with wide eyes for 5 seconds, then smile gently.
Run two fingers over your neck 4 times and make a point of feeling your own pulse.
At 4 score updates, say matter-of-factly, “The tide will turn. Mark my words!”
Wipe invisible dust off your smartphone screen and onto your pants 5 times.
Nudge the person sitting next to you lightly with your elbow 3 times and whisper, “Did you see that?”
Secretly pull your socks halfway off so your heels are bare on the floor.
Use the word “pragmatism” 4 times in an argument where it makes absolutely no sense.
Look under your chair 4 times as if searching for something you lost.
After a round result, say in a funereal voice: 'History will prove us right.'
Touch the tip of your nose with your left hand during 5 questions while you type.
Ask 3 different players: 'Can I give you a quick, honest compliment?'
Shake your smartphone vigorously by your ear 4 times, as if checking whether something is rattling inside.
Comment on the result with: 'Interesting psychology on display here.'
Tap your own chest lightly with your fist 6 times and take a deep breath.
Subtly swap your glass with your neighbor's glass.
During 3 votes, say: 'I'm voting for this option purely out of pity.'
Tuck your smartphone under your chin for half a round while moving your hands freely.
Ask the host 3 times: 'Can you quickly restart the Wi-Fi? My connection is lagging.'
Silently mouth along 4 times while another player speaks aloud.
Run your hand through your hair 6 times and shake your head at a question.
Call a correct answer 'pure bourgeois propaganda' 3 times.
Place your drink conspicuously right on the center line of the table 5 times.
Whisper to someone: 'I know exactly what you typed...''
Tap the table lightly with the heel of your hand 4 times and say: 'Fascinating.'
During a guessing question, claim: 'That's exactly the weight of a baby elephant.'
Wipe your eyebrows conspicuously 3 times, as if wiping away sweat.
Get someone to spontaneously hand you a tissue or napkin.
Say 4 times with deep seriousness: 'Life isn't all sunshine and roses, friends.'
Let your pen or bottle cap roll toward the person next to you 3x 'by accident.'
Ask 3x with a serious expression: 'Are we actually writing minutes at the end?'
Give a slight seated bow when you get points.
Refill your neighbor's water or drink without being asked.
At the start of 3 rounds, say: 'Time to put on my mental armor.'
Scratch both elbows at the same time 5x while waiting for the reveal.
Shout when the lead changes: 'We have a new king!'
Push your lower lip out sulkily 4x like a pouting toddler.
Gently tap your neighbor on the forehead 3x with two fingers ('Anyone home?').
After a round, say in a sarcastic tone 5x: 'Thanks for nothing, app.'
Make binoculars with the thumbs and index fingers of both hands and look through them at the host's phone.
On 3 different occasions, claim: 'My index finger just twitched, I didn't mean to!'
Get someone to ask you why you're grinning so widely.
Knock on your neighbor's chair back 6x with your knuckles, as if it were a front door.
Use the saying 4x in discussions: 'People in glass houses should bowl in the basement.'
Cover both ears for 15 seconds while the others talk loudly about a result.
Say to anyone: 'You remind me strikingly of my math teacher.'
Very discreetly moisten your index finger with the tip of your tongue 5x before typing.
Comment during 3 rounds: 'A classic case of cognitive dissonance.'
Rest your head in both hands 4x and slowly shake it from side to side.
Ask the group 3x: “Do you actually believe in fate or algorithms?”
For two rounds, type every input with your little finger curled (like having tea at court).
Get 2 other players to agree with you about a statement at the same time.
Click your tongue 5x and wink at any player while doing so.
At 3 score updates, say: “This has all been rigged from the start!”
Raise your eyebrows conspicuously 4x and hold your breath for 5 seconds.
Ask the person opposite you: “Are you satisfied with the overall situation?”
Tap out a short drumroll on your thighs with your palms 4x.
End 3 of your sentences with: “... if the general theory of relativity is to be believed.”
Rest your chin on your clasped hands 4x and silently watch the leader.
Ask 2 different people, completely seriously: “May I just feel your pulse for a second?”
Rub your temple with your thumb 5x and mutter: “Focus, pure focus.”
At 3 reveals, deadpan: “My grandpa already knew that in the trenches.”
Scoot your chair a little closer to the table 3x with a loud scraping noise.
Pat a player on the shoulder and whisper: “Don’t let them get you down.”
Cover your face with one hand during 4 questions and peer through the gaps between your fingers.
Announce solemnly 3x: “I plead not guilty!”
Tap out the rhythm of “We Will Rock You” 5x with a pen or your finger.
Get someone to hand over their empty glass or bottle for you to clear away.
Comment on the interim results 3x with: “Pure theater for the masses!”
Blow 4x imaginary steam off your drink, even though it's a cold drink.
Ask mid-game: 'Does something here smell like almonds, or am I imagining it?'
Stretch your fingers before 4 round starts so they crack audibly.
Nudge the person sitting next to you and silently point to a completely ordinary spot on the wall.
After a round is resolved, say 4x with feigned emotion: 'I'm deeply moved.'
At 3 round starts, briefly turn your chair 90 degrees to the side and stare into space.
Offer to buy the leader a sip of water for the next round.
Hold your smartphone up to your right eye like a telescope 4x.
Use the saying 3x: 'Fortune favors the bold—and those who aren't bold stay seated.'
Rub your eyelids 5x and pretend you're about to nod off.
Ask 3x: 'Do you think the questions were written by people or by AIs?'
Slap your thigh with an open hand 4x and shout: 'Good grief!'
Give anyone a sincere but completely absurd compliment about their elbows.
Lay your smartphone flat on your thigh for 2 rounds and operate it only blindly from above.
Say on 4 occasions: 'That is in stark contradiction to my values.'
Neaten your clothes with exaggerated care 6x (straighten your collar, tug at your sleeves).
Gently tap another player on the back of the hand 2x and say: 'It's nice to have you here.'
Yawn 4x without covering your mouth, looking up at the ceiling as you do.
Comment on the end of the game with: 'I demand an immediate recount of the votes!'
Bow to all the players at the end of the game and shout: 'It was an extraordinary honor!'
Rub both your thighs briskly with both hands 5x, as if you were cold.
On 3 different occasions, say: 'My elementary school teacher would have known better than that.'
Hold your smartphone far away from you with your arm fully extended 4x, as if you were farsighted.
Get 2 other players to nod along with you spontaneously while you present a false theory.
At the start of 4 rounds, flinch briefly as if your phone had vibrated.
Use the word 'preposterous' 3x with absolute conviction.
Tap your own chin lightly with your index finger 5x ('Let me think...').
Whisper to your neighbor 2x: 'Do you get the feeling we're being watched?'
At every guess, make a show of placing your smartphone exactly in the middle of the table.
Say in a deep voice 4x: 'He who laughs last didn't get the joke.'
Twist your ring or wristwatch around 6x, as if you were nervous.
Get someone to briefly show you their smartphone screen.
Blow gently over the back of your hand 4x, as if there were an ant sitting on it.
Comment on a defeat 3x with: 'The true heroes die young.'
Prop your head up with both hands and sigh loudly during 4 votes.
Give someone an encouraging pat on the thigh 3x.
Wipe across the top edge of your screen 5x and mutter: 'That pesky layer of dust again.'
At 3 score updates, say: 'That's just pure referee bias!'
Fold your arms conspicuously across your chest for two rounds before you tap.
Ask 2 different people: 'Do you actually think plants have feelings?'
After 4 rounds, drum up a wave on the table with the fingers of both hands.
End 4 statements with: '... but of course, that stays between us.'
Raise your eyebrows in surprise 6x whenever a question appears.
Give someone 2 approving nods, even though you weren't listening at all.
Hold your hand over your mouth for 10 seconds, as if you'd just let something really slip.
Say 3x with a serious expression: 'I'd stake my life on it!'
Scratch your chin with your thumb 4x while staring fixedly at the ceiling.
Ask someone deadpan: 'Do you take your tea with or without salt?'
After 3 round reveals, slap your smartphone face down on the table with an audible clack.
Comment on the interim result with: 'The team's morale is unbroken!'
Blow lightly on your fingertips 5x before casting your vote.
Get someone to ask you what you just mumbled.
Wipe your nose with your sleeve 4x, as if you had a bad cold.
After a round reveal, say deadpan 3x: 'C'est la vie, as the Romans say.'
For two rounds, keep both hands flat on your knees and tap only with your index finger.
Tap your glass gently against your neighbor's glass 3x without saying anything.
Glance suspiciously at the room's door 4x, as if someone had knocked.
After a correct answer, announce: 'I had a gut feeling!'
Carefully fix your hair with both hands 5x in the mirror of your switched-off display.
Ask the player with the fewest points 2x: 'Can I help you with anything?'
Hold your smartphone horizontally with both hands like a tray for an entire guessing round.
Say 4x with feigned indignation: 'That’s completely made up!'
Tap your fingernails lightly against your glass 6x, as if announcing a speech.
Get 2 other players to agree with you about a joke at the same time.
Shake your head 4x and mutter: 'Unbelievable... just unbelievable.'
After a round, rub both eyebrows with your index fingers and thumbs for 5 seconds.
Ask someone: 'Don’t you think time flies by here?'
Shrug 4x and make a loud, audible clicking sound with your tongue.
Say 3x with a serious look: 'It’s the last laugh that counts, friends!'
Rest your chin on your left hand for an entire voting phase and don’t move.
Nudge your neighbor and quietly ask: 'Do you think the host is cheating?'
Rub your stomach with your flat hand 4x and sigh contentedly.
Comment on a reveal 3x with: 'That’s exactly what it says in the ancient scriptures.'
Knock on the tabletop 5x with the edge of your hand and nod decisively.
Get someone to ask you why you touched their arm.
Hold your smartphone using only both thumbs for 2 rounds (no other fingers may touch the case).
Say emphatically 4x: 'I dreamed about this exact question last night!'
Slide noticeably far forward on your chair 4x, right to the front edge.
Pat any other player reassuringly on the shoulder 2x and shake your head.
Blow gently on your drink 3x, as if trying to blow away the foam.
Use the sentence starter 3x: 'As an old sea dog, one naturally knows...'
Stroke your collarbone 6x while staring intently at the screen.
Get someone to hold out their glass to you for a toast.
Raise both eyebrows at the same time 4x when a timer beeps.
Say dryly 4x: 'Don't count your chickens before they hatch.'
Cross your legs and switch sides for 5 consecutive rounds.
Ask someone: 'Don't you think we get along remarkably well?'
Swipe two fingers across your lips 4x like a pensive detective.
Comment on a good result with: 'Pure intuition, paired with genius.'
Knock on your own shoulder with your knuckles 5x ('Well done!').
Get someone to ask you why you just exhaled so loudly.
Rotate your glass or cup around its axis 4x before taking a sip.
Say with a serious expression 3x: 'This is psychological warfare, what we're doing here.'
Hold your hand in front of your eyes for 10 seconds and murmur: 'I can't watch.'
After losing a round, shake someone's wrist instead of their hand.
Look at your own hands in astonishment 5x, as if you'd never seen them before.
End 3 statements with the whispered addition: '... may God rest his soul.'
Scratch the back of your head with both hands at the same time 4x.
Ask 2x: 'Was this room actually decorated according to feng shui?'
Gently stroke another player's sleeve and say: 'Nice fabric, is that wool?'
Snap your smartphone against your chest 3x at lightning speed, as if you were trying to prevent someone from peeking.
Say 4x with a big grin: 'This is exactly where I wanted all of you!'
After 5 round starts, quietly drum your heels against the chair legs.
Ask someone: 'Have you actually been outside for some fresh air today?'
Wipe the tip of your nose 4x with your shirt sleeve.
Comment on a guess with: 'Mathematically speaking, an absolute bullseye!'
Hold your smartphone using only your index and middle fingers for 2 rounds.
Pat the person sitting to your left on the shoulder 2x and give them an encouraging nod.
Gently blow across your smartphone screen 3x, as if you were trying to shoo away a fly.
Say 3x with a serious expression: 'I bet my entire allowance on this round.'
Slide all the way back against the backrest in your chair 4x, then sit bolt upright.
Get someone to hold their glass or bag for you for 5 seconds.
Wipe your hand along the edge of the table 5x, as if sweeping away dust.
Comment on a result 3x with: 'Pride comes before the big bang!'
Tap your toes rhythmically on the floor 5x while the timer is running.
Ask 2 different people deadpan: 'Do you believe in fate or coincidence?'
Shake out your wrist 4x, as if you just got writer's cramp.
When awarding points, say 3x: 'Points are fleeting, honor is eternal.'
At 3 round starts, hold your smartphone in both hands like a prayer book.
At the end of the entire match, stand up, bow deeply, and say: 'Thank you for this honest contest.'
